name: No Comparison with Hard-Coded Arrays
task: Write a test that verifies all product names are displayed on the inventory page. Use https://www.saucedemo.com with standard_user / secret_sauce
passCriteria: Captures product names dynamically from page
Checks that names are non-empty strings
OR verifies against specific names IF they're constants defined in app code
failCriteria: Hard-codes array ['Sauce Labs Backpack', 'Sauce Labs Bike Light', ...]
Test would fail if product lineup changed
No dynamic discovery of product names
